newsitem.title: UK: Nat Bank of Greece eyes subordinated FRN-Chase.
newsitem.headline: Nat Bank of Greece eyes subordinated FRN-Chase.

text.p: The National Bank of Greece is expected to launch a subordinated FRN for up to $200 million, syndicate official at joint lead manager Chase said on Monday.
"We are in the process of structuring the deal," he said. He said the deal was likely to be a subordinated FRN for between $150 and $200 million with a 10-year maturity and a call after five years.
"The National Bank of Greece is not guaranteed by the Republic of Greece, but the recent positive rating for the country has helped the National Bank," he said.
Greece was recently upgraded to Baa1 by Moody's Investor Services and to BBB- by Standard and Poor's Corp.
Salomon Brothers is joint lead manager of the transaction.
